description: This Java interface defines a repository for OTA package information, including custom query methods for retrieving OTA package data and checking package usage within device profiles.

classes.name: OtaPackageInfoRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for OTA package information, providing methods for querying OTA packages and checking their usage.

methods.name: findAllByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of OTA package info entities filtered by tenant ID and optional search text.

methods.name: findAllByTenantIdAndTypeAndDeviceProfileIdAndHasData
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of OTA package info entities filtered by tenant ID, device profile ID, package type, and presence of data or URL.

methods.name: findOtaPackageInfoById
methods.description: Fetches detailed OTA package info by its unique ID.

methods.name: isOtaPackageUsed
methods.description: Checks if a specific OTA package is used by any device profile or device, based on package ID, device profile ID, and package type.
